description: Return a Smithsonian object's CC0 (open-access) images at multiple resolutions, in catalog order, with cc0_image_count. An object with no CC0 image fails with its own reason: nothing digitized, media that is entirely non-image (3D models, scanned books, documents), or images that are all non-CC0. Page a long image list with start and limit: omit limit to get every image from start, and a start at or past cc0_image_count returns an empty images list. Each image includes a thumbnail (~150px), a screen-size image (~1,200px on the long edge), and a full-size JPEG — with pixel dimensions when the catalog lists a high-resolution JPEG — plus an archival TIFF when one exists. The cc0_only filter on smithsonian_search_objects surfaces objects that have downloadable CC0 images.

id.description: record_id of the object (e.g. "nasm_A19670093000") from smithsonian_search_objects or smithsonian_get_object.

limit.description: Images to return from start. Omit to return every image from start. A value above 1000 is served at 1000 with a notice.

start.description: Offset into the CC0 images, 0-indexed in catalog order. A truncated page names the next start in its notice.

name: smithsonian_get_media

cap.description: The page size served: limit as requested, or its cap when limit exceeded it.

cc0_image_count.description: CC0 images on the record before paging — the same count as smithsonian_get_object's media_summary.cc0_image_count.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: No object with the given ID exists in the Smithsonian catalog. `no_media`: The object exists but has no digitized online media. `no_images`: The object has digitized media, but none of it is an image — the media is entirely non-image types such as 3D models, scanned books, or documents. `not_cc0`: The object has media but none of its images are CC0 open access. `invalid_id`: The ID is empty or contains only whitespace. `api_key_rejected`: The Smithsonian API refused this server's SMITHSONIAN_API_KEY (an api.data.gov API_KEY_* error). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

images.description: The CC0 images from start in catalog order: limit of them, or every remaining one when limit is omitted. Empty when start is at or past cc0_image_count.

items.description: A single CC0 image item with resolution variants.

alt_text.description: Accessibility alt text for the image.

high_res_jpeg.description: Full-size JPEG: the catalog's high-resolution JPEG with its pixel dimensions, or, when it lists none, the image's full-size delivery URL with no dimensions. Absent only when the image has neither.

url.description: Direct download URL for the image.
Direct download URL for the image.

is_cc0.description: True when this specific image is CC0 (may differ from the object-level flag). Always true on returned images — non-CC0 images are filtered out before the response.

screen_url.description: Screen-size URL (~1,200px on the long edge), or the full-size delivery URL when the catalog lists no screen image.

is_cc0.description: True when the object-level metadata is CC0. The Open Access corpus is CC0 throughout, so this rarely varies; the per-image is_cc0 flag is what gates delivery.

mirror_snapshot.description: Publication time (ISO 8601) of the Open Access snapshot the mirror held; what came from oa_mirror reflects the catalog as of then. Present when part of this answer came from oa_mirror.

notice.description: Guidance naming the start that retrieves the images this page omitted. Opens with the page size served when limit exceeded its cap.

record_id.description: Smithsonian catalog record ID for the object.

shown.description: Number of images returned in this page.

sources.description: Where this answer came from. A page served from oa_mirror lists its rows in mirror order, not the live API's, and its notice names the snapshot date. Present only on a server that keeps a mirror.

items.description: oa_mirror: the server's local copy of the Smithsonian Open Access bulk metadata. edan_api: the live Smithsonian API.

title.description: Object title from the catalog record.

truncated.description: True when CC0 images remain past this page. Absent on a page that reaches the last image, and on a start past it.

truncationCeiling.description: CC0 images on the record (cc0_image_count) — upper bound for omitted images.

title: Get Smithsonian Object Media
